description: Retrieve recorded distributions for an AphiaID or canonical WoRMS LSID in byte-budgeted segments; resume nextResultOffset as resultOffset with unchanged selectors and filters. WoRMS attaches records to individual name usages, so one AphiaID's rows can miss those of its synonyms: includeSynonyms combines the accepted taxon's rows with those of up to 10 synonyms per call, each row tagged sourceAphiaId; consume nextResultOffset before advancing synonymOffset to synonymUnion.nextSynonymOffset with resultOffset 0. Filters apply to the complete fetched set before pagination and combine by conjunction: recordStatus normalizes case and surrounding whitespace before exact matching; others use case-insensitive whole-value equality without trimming. Rows retain duplicates and source order; no rows does not prove biological or taxon absence. A notice names the linked accepted ID, distinguishing an accepted alternative representation from its preferred ID.
